verdict.rationale: A keyless probe found jo's own backend OpenAPI 3.1 spec, with about 405 paths covering auth, users and apple-messages, so a machine-readable API behind the app does exist. However, nothing documents it as a public developer API or shows it matches what the UI and chat surfaces can do. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, public API keys or a developer program, documentation of agent actions (briefings, schedules, integrations) through the API, and hands-on confirmation of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: returned the backend's OpenAPI 3.1 spec ('"openapi":"3.1.0"', FastAPI, ~405 paths incl. /v1/auth/*, /v1/users/*, /v1/apple-messages/*) with the Swagger UI served at /docs
